newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Drug experts alarmed at rise in Asian heroin use.
newsitem.headline: Drug experts alarmed at rise in Asian heroin use.

text.p: United Nations drug experts warned on Tuesday of an alarming rise in heroin use in Asia and said it could fuel the spread of AIDS.
U.N. Drug Control Programme advisor Richard Dickins said in an interview the three main illegal drugs used in Asia were opium, heroin and amphetamine-type stimulants.
But he said there was an alarming trend for more people, mostly lower income, to use heroin, which is frequently injected into the veins.

"When you have needle use ... you can expect an increase in HIV, which is frightening for all of us," he said, referring the human immunodeficiency virus that causes Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS).
Dickins gave no figures on the increased use of heroin.
